description: Call this first. It checks everything a send would, without sending, and returns `steps` in order — each with `done`, `owner` (`agent`: you; `person`: someone you must ask), `what` and `how` — plus `next`, the first not done, and `ready_to_send`. When `owner` is `person`, tell them exactly what `how` says: return the signup code, publish the DNS `records` listed, or give you a key that can send. Pass `identity_id` to ask about one address; without it you get the one nearest to sending.
name: get_setup
title: What stands between you and sending
